inscription carrier

  • CURIE: gmeow:inscriptionCarrier
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/inscriptionCarrier
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence

The physical object that bears an inscription. Functional: an inscription is borne by exactly one carrier (if a copy exists on another carrier, it is a distinct Inscription instance).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Inscription -> gmeow:PhysicalObject; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:inscriptionCarrier from gmeow:Inscription to gmeow:PhysicalObject when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
